note: Every number was read from the agency's own publication on 2026-11-12 and compared again with that publication, opened afresh, on 2026-11-19 (sources[].checkedAt): all limits, amounts, rates and ages match. CalEITC and the Young Child Tax Credit use tax year 2025 figures because the 2026 figures are not final. Married filing separately with a qualifying child is 'Possible' for the three tax credits: the separated-spouse exception depends on facts the app does not ask.

programs.name: Federal Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)
docsRequired: Social Security cards (or SSA verification letter) for you, your spouse, and each qualifying child
Birth dates for everyone on the return
Forms W-2 and 1099 and other records of income
Last year's federal and state returns, if you have them

Forms W-2 (California wages) and records of self-employment income
If you use an ITIN: identity documents, if FTB asks for them

docsRequired: Proof of income received in the last 30 days
Immigration documents for noncitizens who are applying for benefits
Helpful: rent and utility costs, child care costs, child support paid, and medical costs for members 60+ or disabled

programs.name: California LifeLine (phone discount)
docsRequired: Proof that someone in your household is in a qualifying program (ID card or notice of eligibility), or
Proof of income: front page of last year's tax return, 3 months of pay stubs in a row, or benefit statements

programs.name: CARE (energy bill discount)
docsRequired: A gas or electric account in your name (or your landlord's bill if your home is sub-metered)
Proof of income or of a qualifying program, if the utility asks
